# Continuum

> Use Continuum from Claude, ChatGPT, or the app to plan, make, publish, and optimize on-brand creative across organic and paid.

Every page of the Continuum docs in navigation order, as markdown. Each section starts with the page title and its source. The page map is [llms.txt](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/llms.txt).

# Continuum documentation

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/index

> Continuum is the creative factory for performance marketers, designers, and agencies. Use it from Claude or ChatGPT, or in the app, to plan, make, publish, and optimize on-brand content across organic and paid.

Continuum connects to your social and ad accounts, builds a brand book from your website, and puts both to work. It analyzes what's performing, recommends the next move, generates on-brand creative, publishes it, and writes results back into the plan. Data in, better creative out.

You can use all of it from the AI assistant you already have open, or in the Continuum app.

## Start where you work

* [In Claude or ChatGPT](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/quickstart.md): Add one connector, sign in, and ask. The fastest way to start.
* [In Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/quickstart.md#connect-your-assistant): One command or one config entry. Sign in with your Continuum login.
* [In the Continuum app](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/setup.md): Set up your brand from your website in a few minutes.
* [For your assistant](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/agent-brief.md): A brief your assistant can read to use Continuum well.

## Three product lines

| Product line | What it covers |
| - | - |
| [Creative+](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md) | The AI Canvas, pipelines, elements, Video Studio, Forge, and your Library. |
| [Organic+](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/overview.md) | Plan from the trends, draft with the Organic agent, and publish from the calendar. |
| [Performance+](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/overview.md) | The Optimizer proposes. Jaina explains. You approve. |

## Which surface when

| You want to | Ask your assistant | Or, in the app |
| - | - | - |
| Know what's working and why | "Ask Jaina why our cost per purchase jumped last week." | [Paid analytics](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/analytics.md), [Organic analytics](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/analytics.md) |
| Plan next week's posts | "Plan next week's Instagram content around our autumn launch." | [Content calendar](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/calendar.md) |
| Make on-brand creative | "Turn this product photo into three vertical lifestyle images for Reels." | [AI Canvas](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md) |
| Move budget where it works harder | "Show me this week's budget recommendations and explain each one." | [Paid optimization](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/optimizer.md) |
| Make many versions of a design | "Write six versions of the promo template from this brief." | [Forge](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/forge/overview.md) |
| See what competitors run | "Which competitor ads have been running the longest?" | [Brand Spy](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/spy.md) |

## What Continuum is not

| You might expect | What it is instead |
| - | - |
| An AI ad generator | A loop. Creative is made from your performance data and brand book, and results flow back into the next plan. |
| An assistant that spends on its own | New campaigns are created paused, and budget moves wait for your approval. See [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md). |
| A brand compliance gate | The [brand readiness score](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/readiness.md) tells you how complete your brand book is. It never blocks anything. |

# Quickstart

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/quickstart

> Everything to go from nothing to a first answer: what you need, how to connect Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, or any MCP client, how to check it worked, and the five questions to ask first.

The fastest way to use Continuum is from the AI assistant you already have open. Connect it once, then ask in your own words. You sign in with your normal Continuum login in the browser: there's no key to copy, and your assistant never sees your password.

How connecting works: 1. Paste the address. 2. Sign in to Continuum. 3. Pick a brand. 4. Allow access (your step). 5. Ask.

## Before you start

| You need | Why |
| - | - |
| A Continuum login with access to a brand | Your assistant always works on one brand. If a teammate invited you, accept the email invite. If you're new, see **No brand yet?** below. |
| An assistant that allows custom connectors | Claude (web, desktop, or mobile), ChatGPT with **Developer mode**, or any MCP client. On a Claude Team or Enterprise plan, your organization owner may need to add the connector first. |
| The right role for what you'll do | **Viewer** can read results: analytics, the brand book, the calendar, and the Library. Asking Jaina or the Organic agent, drafting, publishing, generating, or changing ads needs **Operator** or higher. See [Roles](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md). |
| The right plan for what you'll use | Connecting an assistant needs no plan of its own. Organic+ and Performance+ each need their plan on the brand, set under **Settings → Billing** (see [pricing](https://trycontinuum.ai/#pricing)), and Creative+ generation draws on the brand's Canvas credits. In the app, a product line that isn't on the brand's plan shows as locked. |

### No brand yet?

**1. Start onboarding**

Go to [app.trycontinuum.ai](https://app.trycontinuum.ai), enter your website URL, and select **Analyze my brand**. Continuum builds your brand book from the site in a few minutes.

**2. Review and launch**

Check what it found (name, logo, colors, typography, voice, and audience), then launch. You can connect channels and invite your team now or later. The full flow is in [Set up your brand](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/setup.md).

## Server addresses

| Assistant | Address |
| - | - |
| Claude, and every other assistant that supports custom connectors | `https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp` |
| ChatGPT | `https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/chatgpt` |

> [!WARNING]
>
> ChatGPT needs its own address. If ChatGPT won't finish signing in, check that you used the `/mcp/chatgpt` address.

## Connect your assistant

### Claude

**1. Add the connector**

Go to **Settings → Connectors**, choose **Add custom connector**, name it `Continuum`, and paste `https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp`.

**2. Sign in**

Click **Connect**, sign in to Continuum, pick the brand to connect, and click **Allow access**.

The connector also works in the Claude mobile app. On a Claude Team or Enterprise plan, your organization owner may need to add it before you can use it. If you don't see **Add custom connector**, your Claude plan or organization doesn't allow custom connectors.

### ChatGPT

**1. Turn on developer mode**

Go to **Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings** and switch on **Developer mode**. You only do this once. If you don't see **Developer mode**, your ChatGPT plan or workspace admin doesn't allow custom connectors.

**2. Add the connector**

Choose **Create**, name it `Continuum`, and paste `https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/chatgpt`. ChatGPT needs this address, not the plain `/mcp` one.

**3. Sign in**

Sign in to Continuum, pick the brand to connect, and click **Allow access**.

### Claude Code

Run `claude mcp add --transport http continuum https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp`.

Then run `/mcp` inside Claude Code, choose `continuum`, and sign in to Continuum in the browser window it opens.

### Cursor

Add Continuum to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` to use it in every project, or to `.cursor/mcp.json` for one project:

In `~/.cursor/mcp.json`: `{"mcpServers":{"continuum":{"url":"https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp"}}}`

Open **Cursor Settings → MCP**, find `continuum`, and sign in to Continuum when Cursor asks.

### VS Code

Run **MCP: Add Server** from the Command Palette and choose **HTTP**, or add Continuum to `.vscode/mcp.json`:

In `.vscode/mcp.json`: `{"servers":{"continuum":{"type":"http","url":"https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp"}}}`

The first time Copilot uses it, VS Code opens a browser window to sign in to Continuum.

### Codex

Run `codex mcp add continuum --url https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp`, then `codex mcp login continuum`.

The login command opens a browser window to sign in to Continuum.

### Any other assistant

Any assistant that supports custom (remote) MCP connectors can use `https://api.trycontinuum.ai/mcp`. Add it as a remote server, then sign in to Continuum in the browser window it opens.

## Check that it worked

Start a new chat and ask:

> "Which Continuum brand am I working on, and what's connected?"

You should get the brand's name and a list of its connected platforms. If your assistant says it has no Continuum tools, or sign-in keeps failing, see [Assistant troubleshooting](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/troubleshooting.md#in-your-ai-assistant).

## What you're allowing

When you click **Allow access**, your assistant works in Continuum as you: only on your brands, only within your [role](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md), and with a preview before anything goes live. [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md) has the details.

### Disconnect

In Continuum, **Settings → Connections** lists every assistant you've connected. Revoke any you no longer use. You can also remove the connector from your assistant's own settings.

## Your first five minutes

Start with these, in order. Each one builds on the last.

**1. Check where you are**

> "Which Continuum brand am I working on, and what's connected?"

You get the brand's name and what's connected. Continuum starts on the brand you last chose in your assistant, or otherwise your active brand in the app. To change it, say "Switch to Acme Coffee."

**2. Connect your channels**

> "Connect our Instagram account."

You get a link to approve the connection. Your Instagram needs to be a Business or Creator account; if it's a personal account, switch it in the Instagram app's settings. Do the same for your Meta ads and any other platform you use.

**3. Ground everything in your brand**

> "Read our brand book and tell me in three lines how we sound."

You get a three-line summary of your voice. From here on, everything the assistant writes is grounded in it.

**4. See how you're doing**

> "How did we do last week on Instagram and on our Meta ads?"

You get last week's numbers for each connected platform, with the posts and ads that stood out.

**5. Decide what's next**

> "Based on that, what's the one thing we should do this week?"

You get one recommendation and the reason for it. Nothing is changed until you ask.

> [!TIP]
>
> Not sure what to ask? Try "What can you help me with in the Calendar?" It's a good way to explore any part of Continuum.

## Or hand it one prompt

Paste this into a new chat once the connector is on. Your assistant runs the five steps above and stops to ask you before connecting anything.

> Use the Continuum connector. Tell me which brand I'm on and which platforms are connected. If Instagram or Meta ads aren't connected, give me the links to connect them and wait. Then read our brand book and summarize how we sound in three lines, show me last week's results on Instagram and Meta ads, and finish with the one thing we should do this week.

## What's next

* [How to ask](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/how-to-ask.md): Be specific, say what decision you're making, and say how you want it back.
* [What you can do](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/overview.md): Every area of Continuum you can use from your assistant.

# Core concepts

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/concepts

> The mental model behind Continuum: brands, the brand book, three product lines, the agents, your AI assistant, and the creative loop.

Continuum brings planning, creative production, publishing, and optimization into one place, all scoped to a brand. A few concepts explain how it fits together.

## Everything is scoped to a brand

A **brand** (or brand profile) is the unit everything hangs off: its [brand book](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/overview.md), connected accounts, media, drafts, and analytics. If you manage more than one brand, you switch the **active brand** from the brand switcher, and the whole app re-scopes to it. In your AI assistant, you say "Switch to Acme Coffee." Each brand keeps its own identity, integrations, and history.

## The brand book grounds everything

Your **brand book** is a living, AI-generated identity — colors, typography, voice, audience, positioning, and guidelines — first drafted from your website and deepened over time. It actively **grounds** generations on the Canvas and steers the agents, so output stays on-brand by default. A **brand readiness score** tracks how complete your brand book is; it's informational and blocks nothing.

## Three product lines

| Product line | What it covers |
| - | - |
| [Creative+](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md) | Make creative on the **AI Canvas**, with pipelines, elements, Video Studio, Forge, and the Library. |
| [Organic+](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/overview.md) | Plan, draft, publish, and analyze organic social with the **Organic agent** and the **Calendar**. |
| [Performance+](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/overview.md) | Run and optimize paid media with **Jaina** and **Paid optimization**. |

## Two agents do the analysis

* **Organic agent** — your social strategist. It plans posts, drafts concepts, generates plans in bulk, searches your media, and hands work into the calendar.
* **Jaina** — your ads analyst. Ask about performance and Jaina returns a structured report: KPIs, insights, and prioritized recommendations.

The **Optimizer** sits beside Jaina in Performance+. The Optimizer proposes budget moves, Jaina explains, and you approve.

## Use it from your AI assistant

Everything above is also reachable from Claude, ChatGPT, or any assistant that supports custom connectors. You connect once with the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/overview.md), sign in with your Continuum login, and ask in your own words. Your role and brand access carry over, and anything that publishes, changes your ads, or deletes something waits for your yes.

## The creative loop

These pieces form a loop you repeat:

**1. Connect**

Link your channels and assign accounts to the brand. See [Integrations](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/integrations.md).

**2. Ground**

Build the [brand book](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/overview.md) that every generation and agent draws from.

**3. Create**

Generate creative on the [AI Canvas](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md) and plan posts on the [calendar](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/calendar.md).

**4. Publish**

Ship organic posts and paid campaigns across your channels.

**5. Optimize**

Read [organic](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/analytics.md) and [paid](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/analytics.md) analytics, then let the agents recommend the next move.

## Key terms

| Term | What it means |
| - | - |
| **Brand / brand profile** | The scope for all work; you can manage several and switch the active one. |
| **Brand book** | The AI-generated brand identity that grounds generations and agents. |
| **Brand readiness score** | A 0–100 measure of how complete your brand book is. Informational only. |
| **AI Canvas** | The node-based surface where you generate and edit creative. Labeled **Canvas** in the app. |
| **Node / workflow** | A single block on the canvas; a saved graph of connected nodes. |
| **Creative** | Produced content (an image, video, or ad). An **asset** is a raw file. |
| **Draft** | A planned organic post in the calendar. |
| **Connector** | The link that lets Claude, ChatGPT, or another assistant work in Continuum for you. |

See the [glossary](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/glossary.md) for the full list.

## Try it

* "Which brand am I working on, and what's connected?"
* "Summarize our brand book in five lines: voice, audience, and what we never say."
* "What worked best on Instagram last month, and what should we make next because of it?"

# Glossary

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/glossary

> The Continuum-specific words the rest of the docs use, defined once each.

| Term | Definition |
| - | - |
| **Active brand** | The brand your session is working on. Switch it from the brand switcher, or ask your assistant to switch. |
| **AI Canvas** | The infinite node canvas where you generate and edit creative. Labeled **Canvas** in the app. |
| **Asset** | A raw file (an upload). Contrast with **creative**. |
| **Brand book** | Your living, AI-generated brand identity. It grounds generations and agents. Lives under **Settings → Brand Intelligence**. |
| **Brand kit** | The core identity: logo, brand colors, and typography. |
| **Brand readiness score** | A 0–100 measure of how complete your brand book is. Informational; blocks nothing. |
| **Brand Spy** | The competitor-intelligence workspace, in Creative+. |
| **Calendar** | The organic content calendar, also called the **Planner**, where drafts are planned and scheduled. |
| **Composer** | The canvas agent. Describe a workflow and it builds the graph. |
| **Connector** | The link that lets Claude, ChatGPT, or another assistant work in Continuum for you, over MCP. |
| **Creative** | Produced content — an image, video, or ad. |
| **Creative+** | The product line for making creative: the AI Canvas, pipelines, Elements, Video Studio, the Library, Forge, and Brand Spy. |
| **Creative skill** | A reusable creative-direction directive applied to a generation. |
| **Draft** | A planned organic post in the calendar. |
| **Element** | A saved model, product, character, or style that stays consistent across generations. |
| **Forge** | Fills your design templates with your messages, products, and offers to render many versions. |
| **Grounding** | Steering a generation with your brand book, creative direction, and design system. |
| **Jaina** | The ads analyst agent, in Performance+. |
| **Library** | Your brand's searchable home for all media. |
| **MCP** | Model Context Protocol, the open standard Continuum's connector uses. |
| **Node** | A single block on the canvas: a prompt, reference, generator, edit, or delivery step. |
| **Optimizer** | Paid optimization. It proposes budget moves across portfolios for you to approve. |
| **Organic agent** | Your social strategist agent, in Organic+. |
| **Organic+** | The product line for organic social: the Organic agent, the calendar, publishing, and analytics. |
| **Performance+** | The product line for paid media: Jaina, paid analytics, and Paid optimization. |
| **Pipeline** | A canvas graph published with declared inputs, so your team and your assistant can run it with new material. |
| **Portfolio** | A group of ad sets the Optimizer works over. |
| **Technique** | A saved selection of canvas nodes you can drop into any graph. |
| **Video Studio** | The timeline video editor. |
| **Workflow** | A saved canvas graph you can reload and rerun. |
| **Workspace** | A canvas tab for the brand. |

# Continuum in your AI assistant

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/overview

> Connect Continuum to Claude or ChatGPT and put your brand book, results, and content plan to work by asking.

Continuum works from your brand book, your audience, your past performance, and your creative library. Connect it to Claude or ChatGPT and you can put all of that to work by asking, in one conversation.

The connection uses the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**. Claude and ChatGPT call it a **connector**: a secure link that lets your assistant work in Continuum for you. You paste one address, sign in with your normal Continuum login, and you're done.

* [Connect your assistant](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/quickstart.md#connect-your-assistant): Claude, ChatGPT, or any assistant that supports custom connectors.
* [Your first five minutes](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/quickstart.md): Connect, pick a brand, and ask your first five questions.

## Why use it

* **Get answers in plain English.** Ask why your cost per purchase jumped and get the numbers, the likely reason, and a suggested next step.
* **Plan and publish from one conversation.** Go from "what should we post next week?" to an approved calendar, and publish to Instagram when you're ready.
* **Make on-brand creative.** Captions, images, and videos are drafted from your brand book and past results. You review them before anything is published.
* **Stay in control.** Anything that publishes, changes your ads or budgets, or deletes something shows you a preview and waits for your yes. See [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md).

## The parts of Continuum you'll hear about

Start with what you want to get done and ask for it in your own words. This table explains the names you'll hear along the way. You can use every area from your assistant. A few steps stay in the Continuum app on purpose, like turning on Autopilot, and switching on a campaign needs an Admin or Owner's approval.

| Name | What it is |
| - | - |
| **[Jaina](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/jaina.md)** | Your ads analyst. Ask her why results changed and what to do next. |
| **[Organic agent](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/agent.md)** | Your social media strategist: ideas, captions, and content plans. |
| **[Calendar](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/calendar.md)** | Your content plan: every post, its date, and whether it's a draft, approved, scheduled, or published. |
| **[Paid optimization](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/optimizer.md)** | Watches your Meta ads and recommends where to move budget, for you to approve. |
| **[Library](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/library.md)** | Every image and video your brand has made, uploaded, or run as an ad. |
| **[Canvas](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md)** | A visual workspace where images and videos are built step by step. You can watch the assistant work on it. |
| **[Pipelines](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/pipelines.md)** | Recipes your team has saved for a type of creative, such as a product lifestyle shot. Run one to get up to 10 versions at once. |
| **[Elements](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/elements.md)** | A saved product, model, or character that looks the same in everything you generate. |
| **[Video Studio](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/video-studio.md)** | The video editor for turning raw footage into cuts for social. |
| **[Forge](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/forge/overview.md)** | Fills your design templates with your messages and offers to make many versions in one go. |

> [!TIP]
>
> Jaina explains why results changed. Paid optimization proposes the budget moves. You approve.

## What you can do

* [Understand your performance](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/performance.md): What's working across social and ads, and why.
* [Know your brand](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/brand.md): Ask about your brand book and check copy against your voice.
* [Find what works](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/insights.md): Your best openings and formats, category trends, and competitors.
* [Plan and publish social](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/social.md): Plan a week of posts, review each one, and publish.
* [Run your Meta ads](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/ads.md): Budgets, audiences, campaigns, and optimization recommendations.
* [Make creative](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/creative.md): On-brand images and video from the Canvas, Pipelines, and Elements.
* [Edit video](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/video.md): Turn raw footage into first cuts in Video Studio.
* [Produce templates at scale](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/templates.md): Fill your design templates with Forge.

* "Which Continuum brand am I working on, and what's connected?"
* "Read our brand book and tell me in three lines how we sound."
* "What can you help me with in the Calendar?"

## What's next

* [How to ask](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/how-to-ask.md): Habits that get better answers faster.

# How to ask

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/how-to-ask

> Ask in your own words. A few habits — be specific, name the decision, say how you want it back — get better answers faster.

There are no special commands. Ask in your own words, and Continuum asks if it needs one more detail. A few habits get you better answers faster.

## Be specific

Name the platform, the time period, the result you care about, and what you want back.

| Instead of | Try |
| - | - |
| "How are our ads doing?" | "Compare our 5 best and 5 worst Meta ads by return on ad spend over the last 30 days, and tell me what the best ones have in common." |
| "Show me spend." | "I need to cut \$2,000 from next week's ad spend. Where should it come from?" |

## Say what decision you're making

"I need to cut \$2,000 from next week's ad spend. Where should it come from?" gets a sharper answer than "Show me spend." The decision tells Continuum which numbers matter.

## Say how you want it back

* "Put that in a table with spend and return for each campaign."
* "Give me three bullet points I can paste into Slack."

## Start from your brand

Opening with "Read our brand book" or "Check what has worked for us before" makes everything that follows more on-brand.

## Preview anything

Publishing, changes to your ads and budgets, and deletions show a preview and wait for your yes ([one exception](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md#what-waits-for-your-yes)). Other changes — moving a post to another day, rewriting a caption, or marking work as needing changes — happen right away, and so does generating creative. Say **"Show me first"** before any change you want to check.

## Correct it like a colleague

If it picks the wrong thing, just say so:

* "Not that one, the spring campaign."
* "Use the last 7 days instead."

## Keep the conversation going

You don't need to start over. Build on what's already there:

> "Turn this product photo into three vertical lifestyle images for Reels."
>
> "Make the second one warmer, with more morning light."
>
> "Now make the same three in square for the feed."
>
> "Add the best one to Tuesday's post."

## Ask what's possible

"What can you help me with in the Calendar?" is a good way to explore any part of Continuum.

## What's next

* [Prompt recipes](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/recipes.md): Short sequences for a Monday review, a launch week, and more.
* [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md): What waits for your yes, and what happens right away.

# Prompt recipes

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/recipes

> Short prompt sequences that show how everything connects: a Monday review, a launch week, refreshing tired ads, and turning footage into clips.

Short sequences that show how everything connects. Use them as they are or adapt them. Send each line as its own message and read the answer before the next one.

## Monday morning review

**1. Compare the weeks**

"Give me last week's social and ad results, compared with the week before."

**2. Find the why**

"What were the best and worst performers, and why?"

**3. Pick one move**

"What's the one change we should make this week?"

## Plan a launch week

**1. Load the context**

"Read our brand book and the brief for the autumn launch."

**2. Find what works**

"Which opening lines and formats have worked best for us?"

**3. Plan**

"Plan launch week on Instagram using those."

**4. Make the creative**

"Make the images for each post and show me the storyboards."

**5. Schedule**

"Schedule the ones I approved."

## Refresh tired ads

**1. Find fatigue**

"Which of our Meta ads are losing attention fastest?"

**2. Look outward**

"What's working for competitors in the same space?"

**3. Make new versions**

"Make three new versions of our weakest ad, using our best opening lines."

**4. Swap one in**

"Swap the strongest new version into that ad. Show me first."

## Turn footage into social clips

**1. Cut**

"Turn my latest video into three 15-second clips: a hook, a testimonial, and a demo."

**2. Finish**

"Add on-brand captions and music to each."

**3. Plan**

"Save them to the Library and add them to next week's posts."

## What's next

* [How to ask](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/how-to-ask.md): Habits that make every recipe sharper.
* [What you can do](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/overview.md): Every area you can reach from your assistant.

# Understand your performance

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/performance

> Ask what's working across your social channels and your ads, and why, in plain English.

Know what's working, what isn't, and why, across your social channels and your ads. For deeper questions, ask [Jaina](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/jaina.md) about ads or the [Organic agent](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/agent.md) about social.

## What you can read

| Area | Platforms |
| - | - |
| **Organic social** | Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn |
| **Ad accounts** | Meta and LinkedIn |

Data appears for each account connected and assigned to your brand. Ask "Which platforms are connected to our brand?" to check, and connect anything missing from the same chat.

## Prompts to try

* "What were our three best Instagram posts last month, and why did they work?"
* "Ask Jaina why our cost per purchase jumped last week."
* "Which Meta campaigns are spending slower than planned this month?"
* "Break down the last two weeks of Meta spend by age and gender. Where are we wasting money?"
* "Which of our video ads hold attention past the first three seconds, and which lose people?"
* "Give me a one-page weekly review of social and ads, with the single most important action."

## Good to know

* Viewers can read the numbers. Asking Jaina or the Organic agent needs the **Operator** role or higher.

> [!TIP]
>
> Answers and reports usually take a minute or two. Ask "Is it done yet?" to check, or come back to the same chat later.

## What's next

* [Jaina](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/jaina.md): The ads analyst behind paid answers.
* [Organic analytics](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/analytics.md): The same numbers, in the app.

# Know your brand

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/brand

> Ask about your brand book, guidelines, and audience, check copy against your voice, and add new material for Continuum to learn from.

Keep every piece of writing on-brand. Ask about your [brand book](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/overview.md), guidelines, and audience, check copy before it goes out, and add new material for Continuum to learn from.

## Prompts to try

* "What does our brand book say about how we talk on LinkedIn?"
* "Check this caption against our brand voice: 'Big news!!! Our new blend is HERE and it's insane.'"
* "Who is our core customer, in two sentences?"
* "Save this product FAQ so you can use it in future posts."

> [!TIP]
>
> Start a session with "Read our brand book." Everything the assistant writes after that is grounded in your voice.

## Good to know

* If your brand isn't ready yet, finish [setting up your brand](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/brand/setup.md) in the Continuum app so your brand book can be built. Until then, you can still connect accounts and look at your performance.
* Material you save is added to your brand's [knowledge base](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/knowledge.md), where it also feeds the agents in the app.
* Reading your brand book and knowledge base needs the **Viewer** role. Saving, updating, or archiving material needs **Operator** or higher.
* To add a PDF or other file, upload it under **Settings → Knowledge** in the app.

## What's next

# Find what works

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/insights

> Base your next post or ad on evidence: your best openings and formats, trends in your category, and what competitors are running.

Base your next post or ad on evidence. Continuum studies your best posts and ads to find the openings, angles, and formats that work for you. It also tracks trends in your category and what your competitors are running.

## Prompts to try

* "Which opening lines work best for us, and what's the proof?"
* "Score this opening line before I post it: 'Stop scrolling if you hate Mondays.'"

* "Which competitor ads have been running the longest? What does that tell us?"
* "Where are competitors winning that we aren't even showing up?"

# Plan and publish social content

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/social

> Plan a week of posts in one conversation, review each one, make the images and video, and publish, while your Calendar updates as you go.

Plan a week of posts in one conversation, then review each one before it goes out. Write the posts, make the images and videos, and publish. Your [Calendar](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/calendar.md) in Continuum updates as you go.

## Where you can publish

Your assistant plans and tracks posts for every connected platform, and publishes to Instagram. [Publishing](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/publishing.md) has the status of every other platform.

## Prompts to try

* "Plan next week's Instagram content around our autumn launch."
* "What's ready to post right now?"
* "Move all of Thursday's posts to Friday."
* "Rewrite this caption in Mexican Spanish and make it more playful."
* "Make the images for Tuesday's post. Show me the storyboard first."
* "Show me Tuesday's approved carousel as it will post, then publish it."

## Good to know

* Publishing always shows you the post as it will go out and waits for your yes.
* Moving a post or rewriting a caption happens right away. A scheduled post you move goes out at its new time, so check the date.
* Your Instagram needs to be a Business or Creator account to connect.
* Viewers can read the calendar and drafts. Planning, editing, approving, and publishing need the **Operator** role or higher.

## What's next

* [Content calendar](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/calendar.md): The plan your assistant writes into.
* [Organic agent](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/agent.md): The strategist behind ideas, captions, and plans.

# Run your Meta ads

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/ads

> Review campaigns, adjust budgets, build audiences, and set up new campaigns, always created paused, from the conversation.

Manage your Meta ads from the conversation. Review campaigns, adjust budgets, pause or update campaigns, ad sets, and ads, build audiences (including lookalikes), and set up new campaigns. New campaigns, ad sets, and ads are always created **paused**, so nothing spends until an Admin or Owner approves switching it on.

[Paid optimization](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/optimizer.md) spots where your budget would work harder and recommends the move, with the reasoning. You approve or reject each one.

## Prompts to try

* "Show me this week's budget recommendations and explain each one."
* "Approve the recommendations for our prospecting campaigns, and reject the rest."
* "Raise the daily budget on our retargeting ads to \$150. Show me the change first."
* "Pause the ad sets with the highest cost per purchase. Show me first."
* "Build a new audience of people similar to our past purchasers in the US."
* "Set up a paused campaign to drive traffic to our spring sale."
* "Show me the paid changes waiting for my approval." (Admins and Owners)

## Good to know

* Creating or changing campaigns, ad sets, ads, budgets, and audiences shows a preview and waits for your yes.
* Approving a Paid optimization recommendation applies it right away. Your approval is the yes.
* Switching a campaign, ad set, or ad on needs an Admin or Owner, who approves that exact change in the Continuum app or from their own assistant with `mcp_approval_grant`. A large budget increase needs the same approval. If you're an Admin or Owner, your own yes is enough.
* Creating or changing ads, and approving or rejecting recommendations, needs the Operator role or higher. Viewers can read campaigns, results, and recommendations.
* Paid optimization recommends budget moves for you to approve. It never pauses an ad unless you approve that specific pause. Your assistant can't switch a portfolio to Autopilot, which makes budget moves automatically; turn it on from the Paid optimization dashboard.

## What's next

* [Paid optimization](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/optimizer.md): How recommendations are made and applied.
* [Jaina](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/jaina.md): Ask why results changed.

# Make creative

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/creative

> Turn one idea into on-brand images and video, then find, review, and approve them in one place.

Turn one idea into on-brand images and videos, then find, review, and approve them in one place.

* **Find anything** in your [Library](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/library.md) by describing it, and see where each creative has run and which version performs best.
* **Build new creative on the [Canvas](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md)** while you watch, then add it to a scheduled post or swap it into a live ad.
* **Make several versions at once with [Pipelines](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/pipelines.md)**, so you can test different ideas side by side.
* **Keep your product or model consistent** across everything you make with [Elements](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/elements.md).
* **Review work together**: leave feedback on a specific spot in an image or moment in a video, and mark work as approved.

## Prompts to try

* "Find our approved product shots on a white background."
* "Which version of this ad creative is winning, and where is it running?"
* "Turn this product photo into three vertical lifestyle images for Reels."
* "Run our customer-testimonial pipeline with these three angles: taste, price, convenience."
* "Put the finished image on next Tuesday's post."
* "Mark this image as needs changes, and leave a note about the logo placement."

## Good to know

* Generation starts right away, without a preview. The Canvas allows up to 10 runs an hour for each brand, and a pipeline makes up to 10 versions per request. If you hit a limit, ask for a smaller batch or try again later.
* If the canvas is open in Continuum, you can watch the assistant build and run it.
* Viewers can search and browse the Library. Working on the canvas, running a pipeline, commenting, and setting review status need the **Operator** role or higher.
* Swapping the creative in a live ad shows a preview first and can be undone.
* You can find, review, comment on, and approve work from your assistant. Editing or deleting comments, collections, and share links are done in the Continuum app.

## What's next

* [AI Canvas](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/overview.md): How the canvas, nodes, and models work.
* [Library](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/library.md): Where every creative lives.

# Edit video

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/video

> Turn raw footage into first cuts for social from your assistant, with every change live in Video Studio and undoable.

Turn raw footage into first cuts for social from your conversation. Every change shows up live in [Video Studio](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/video-studio.md), and you can undo any of them.

## Prompts to try

* "Cut the pauses from my latest video and add captions."
* "Turn this footage into three 30-second customer testimonial cuts."
* "Cut it to the beat of the music."
* "Add a headline at the start and a call to action at the end."
* "Reformat it for Reels and save it to the Library."

## Good to know

* Every edit is saved as a new version you can undo.
* Finished videos are saved to your [Library](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/library.md).
* Editing and exporting need the **Operator** role or higher.

## What's next

# Produce templates at scale

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/use-cases/templates

> Forge fills your design templates with your messages, products, and offers to make many on-brand versions in one go.

A **template** is a design your team has already set up, such as a promo video or a story card. **[Forge](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/forge/overview.md)** fills it with your messages, products, and offers to make many on-brand versions in one go, from a brief or your documents. You preview every version before anything is made.

## Prompts to try

* "Which templates do we have?"
* "Write six versions of the promo template from this brief."
* "Produce the whole set. Show me what will be made first."

## Good to know

* You see a preview of every version, and nothing is made until you confirm.
* Final versions, rather than draft previews, need an **Admin** or **Owner**, even if you're an **Operator**.

## What's next

# You stay in control

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control

> What waits for your yes, what happens right away, what stays in the Continuum app, and how to see and revoke everything your assistant does.

Your assistant works in Continuum as you, inside the limits you already have. Here's exactly what that means.

* **Waits for your yes** (you ask, see a preview, say yes, then it happens): publishing; ads, budgets, and audiences; swapping a live ad's creative; final Forge versions; deleting; switching on an ad, which needs an Admin or Owner.
* **Happens right away** (you ask, it happens): moving a post or rewriting a caption; generating on the canvas; running a pipeline; editing video; approving a recommendation.
* **Stays in the app** (you decide there): turning on Autopilot for budget changes.

## What waits for your yes

Continuum shows you a preview of what will happen and waits for your yes before it:

* **Publishes** a post.
* **Creates, changes, or pauses** a campaign, ad set, ad, budget, or audience in your Meta account. Paid optimization never pauses an ad unless you approve that specific pause.
* **Swaps the creative** in a live ad. The swap can be undone.
* **Produces final versions** in Forge.
* **Deletes** something. The one exception is deleting a Forge render set, which has no preview step; your assistant asks you first.
* **Switches on** a campaign, ad set, or ad. New ones are always created paused. Switching one on needs an Admin or Owner to approve that exact change, in the Continuum app or from their own assistant with `mcp_approval_grant`. A large budget increase needs the same approval. If you're an Admin or Owner, your own yes is enough.

## What happens right away

| Change | Why it doesn't wait |
| - | - |
| Moving a post, rewriting a caption, marking work as needing changes, adding a comment | It stays inside your plan. Nothing is published or spent, but a scheduled post you move goes out at its new time, so check the date. |
| Generating on the Canvas, running a pipeline, editing or exporting video | You asked for the creative. Generation uses your plan's budget, and bigger jobs have [hourly limits](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/limits.md) to protect it. |
| Approving or rejecting a Paid optimization recommendation | Your approval is the yes. |

> [!TIP]
>
> Say **"Show me first"** to preview any change before it's made.

## What stays in the Continuum app

| Decision | Where it happens |
| - | - |
| Autopilot (automatic budget changes) | Turn it on from the Paid optimization dashboard. Your assistant can't switch a portfolio to it. |
| Editing or deleting comments, collections, and share links | In the Continuum app. |

## Your access, and no more

The assistant can reach only the brands you belong to, and do only what your [role](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md) allows. It starts on the brand you last chose in your assistant, or otherwise your active brand in the app, and you can switch to any other brand you belong to by asking. Viewers can read results, plans, and the Library. Operators can also ask Jaina and the Organic agent, and create, change, and run content, creative, and campaigns. Admins and Owners can also manage people and settings, approve switching on ads, and produce final Forge versions.

## See everything it did

In Continuum, **Settings → Activity** lists every action you've taken through a connected assistant: the tool, whether it worked, and when. Each person sees their own activity. Continuum logs a fingerprint of what was asked, never the request itself. If something looks wrong, revoke the connection under **Settings → Connections** and contact [support@trycontinuum.ai](mailto:support@trycontinuum.ai).

## Disconnect at any time

In Continuum, **Settings → Connections** lists every assistant you've connected. Revoke any you no longer use.

## What your assistant sees

Claude or ChatGPT sees what you ask and what Continuum sends back to answer it, such as campaign figures, draft captions, and links to images. It never sees your Continuum password. That conversation follows your assistant's own privacy settings. Continuum's handling of your data is covered in our [privacy policy](https://app.trycontinuum.ai/privacy) and on the [Security](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/security.md) page.

## Try it

* "Raise the daily budget on our retargeting ads to \$150. Show me the change first."
* "Move Thursday's posts to Friday. Show me first."
* "Show me the paid changes waiting for my approval." (Admins and Owners)

## What's next

* [Good to know](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/limits.md): Current limits by area.
* [Roles & permissions](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md): What each role can do.

# Good to know

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/limits

> What to expect in each area when you use Continuum from your assistant: publishing, ads, generation limits, and what stays in the app.

What to expect in each area today.

| Area | What to expect |
| - | - |
| **Publishing** | Live on Instagram. For Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube, contact support before your first post on each, and the Continuum team publishes it with you. TikTok posts publish as private until TikTok's app audit completes. See [Publishing](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/publishing.md). |
| **Ads** | Meta ads can be managed from your assistant. New campaigns, ad sets, and ads start paused. Switching one on, or a large budget increase, needs an Admin or Owner to approve that exact change, in the app or from their own assistant. |
| **Paid optimization** | Recommends budget moves for you to approve, and applies them when you do. It never pauses an ad unless you approve that specific pause. Your assistant can't switch a portfolio to Autopilot, which makes budget moves automatically; turn it on from your dashboard. |
| **Canvas** | Generate images and videos from your assistant. Up to 10 runs an hour for each brand. If the canvas is open in Continuum, you can watch the run happen. |
| **Pipelines** | Up to 10 versions per request. |
| **Live ads** | Swapping the creative in a live ad shows a preview first and can be undone. |
| **Video Studio** | Every edit is saved as a new version you can undo. Finished videos are saved to your Library. |
| **Forge** | You see a preview of every version before anything is made, and nothing is made until you confirm. Final versions need an Admin or Owner, even if you're an Operator. |
| **Library** | Find, review, comment on, and approve work from your assistant. Editing or deleting comments, collections, and share links are done in the Continuum app. |
| **Your role** | Set for each brand in Continuum. Viewers can read results, plans, and the Library. Operators can also ask Jaina and the Organic agent, and create, change, and run content, creative, and campaigns. Admins and Owners can also manage people and settings, approve switching on ads, and produce final Forge versions. See [Roles & permissions](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md). |

## Timing

Answers and reports usually take a minute or two. Images and video can take several minutes. Ask "Is it done yet?" to check, or come back to the same chat later.

## Limits

Hourly limits protect your budget. Most are set for each brand: besides Canvas runs, they cover publishing, approvals, ad changes, and trend discovery. Connection links are limited per person. If you hit one, Continuum says how long to wait. Ask for a smaller batch — three versions instead of ten — or try again later. The [server reference](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/reference.md#limits) lists every limit.

## Try it

* "Run the product-reveal pipeline once for each of these ten headlines." One call queues up to ten versions.
* "Preview the budget change on our prospecting ad set, and wait for my yes before you apply it."
* "Which connections does this brand have, and which ones have lapsed?"

* [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md): Previews, activity, and revoking access.
* [Troubleshooting](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/troubleshooting.md#in-your-ai-assistant): Fixes for the common snags.

# Security & privacy

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/security

> How Continuum controls access: OAuth sign-in with no API keys, role-based permissions, a preview before anything goes live, an activity log, revocable assistant connections, and accounts assigned per brand.

Continuum connects to your ad and social accounts and holds your brand's data. Here's how access is controlled, and how you check and revoke it.

## At a glance

| Area | How it works |
| - | - |
| **Assistant sign-in** | OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, using your Continuum login. No API keys. |
| **Access** | Only the brands you belong to, and only what your role allows. |
| **Going live** | Publishing, ad changes, spending, and deletions show a preview and wait for your yes. |
| **Activity** | **Settings → Activity** lists your assistant actions. |
| **Revoking** | **Settings → Connections** lists every connected assistant. Revoke any of them. |
| **Ad and social accounts** | Connect once, assign to a brand. Nothing syncs until you assign it. |

## Signing in your AI assistant

* Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants connect with **OAuth 2.1**, using the authorization code flow with PKCE.
* There are **no API keys** to create, share, or leak.
* You sign in with your normal Continuum login, pick a brand, and choose **Allow access** or **Deny**.
* Your assistant never sees your Continuum password.

The [server reference](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/reference.md#authentication) has the protocol details.

## Access follows your role

A connected assistant works as you. It reaches only the brands you belong to and does only what your role on each brand allows. What it can do comes from your brands and roles, not from anything granted at sign-in.

| Role | Can do |
| - | - |
| **Viewer** | Read results, plans, and the Library. |
| **Operator** | Also ask Jaina and the Organic agent, and create, change, and run content, creative, and campaigns. |
| **Admin**, **Owner** | Also manage people and settings, approve switching on ads, and produce final versions in Forge. |

See [Roles & permissions](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md).

## Nothing goes live without a yes

Publishing, ad and budget changes, live creative swaps, final Forge versions, and deletions show a preview and wait for your yes. Each yes works once, applies only to the exact change you previewed, and expires. New campaigns, ad sets, and ads are always created **paused**, and switching one on needs an Admin or Owner. [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md) has the full list, the one exception, and what happens right away; the [server reference](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/reference.md#confirmations) has each lifetime.

## See and revoke assistant access

* **Settings → Activity** lists every action you've taken through a connected assistant: the tool, whether it worked, and when. Each person sees their own activity.
* Continuum logs only a fingerprint of what was asked, never the request itself.
* **Settings → Connections** lists every assistant you've connected. Revoke any you no longer use.

If something looks wrong, revoke the connection and contact [support@trycontinuum.ai](mailto:support@trycontinuum.ai). See [Connections and activity](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/connections.md).

## Connected ad and social accounts

Integrations follow one rule: **connect once, assign to a brand.**

* You connect a provider through its own OAuth flow.
* You then assign the specific accounts that belong to each brand. Nothing syncs until you assign it, so data stays separate between the brands you manage.
* You can disconnect a provider or remove an assignment at any time from **Settings → Integrations**.

See [Integrations](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/integrations.md).

## Sharing work outside your account

A Library **share link** lets a client or partner see work without an account. You choose whether they can download, comment, or approve, and you can add a passcode. You can also lock a comment so it stays internal. See [Library](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/canvas/library.md).

## What your assistant sees

Claude or ChatGPT sees what you ask and what Continuum sends back to answer it, such as campaign figures, draft captions, and links to images. That conversation follows your assistant's own privacy settings. Continuum's handling of your data is covered in our [privacy policy](https://app.trycontinuum.ai/privacy).

## Requesting details

For data handling, retention, subprocessors, compliance, or documentation for a security review, contact [support@trycontinuum.ai](mailto:support@trycontinuum.ai).

## Try it

* Ask your assistant: "Which brand am I working on, and what's my role on it?" It answers with the brand and your role, so you know what it can do for you.
* To cut off an assistant, go to **Settings → Connections**, find it, and revoke it.

## What's next

* [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md): What waits for your yes, and what happens right away.
* [Roles & permissions](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md): What each role can do.
* [Connections and activity](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/connections.md): Review and revoke connected assistants.
* [Integrations](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/integrations.md): Connect platforms and assign them to a brand.

# Tool reference

Source: https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools

> All 52 tools the Continuum connector lists, and the 20 more it accepts by name: what each does, whether it changes anything, and where its full contract lives.

{/* Generated by scripts/mcp-docs.mjs from drafts/mcp/source.json; edit scripts/mcp-notes.mjs instead. */}

You don't need to know tool names to use Continuum. Your assistant picks them for you. This page is for admins reviewing what a connector can do and for anyone building with an agent.

The server registers **72 tools**. Your assistant's tool list (`tools/list`) shows up to **52** of them: the ones your [role](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/settings/roles.md) and connected platforms allow. The other **20** are writes and helpers reached through the listed tools; they stay callable by name. `help_describe` with no arguments returns all 72.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Tools marked **Changes things** can modify your brand. The ones that publish, change your ads, produce final Forge versions, or delete something show a preview and wait for your yes. See [You stay in control](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/control.md).

## For agents

* **Index:** [`/mcp/tools.json`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools.json) lists every registered tool with its role, connection, confirmation, completion, retry behavior, actions with required and optional inputs, an example call, and its errors. Generated from the server's own tool registry, as released on 2026-11-05.
* **Live schema:** call `help_describe {"tool": "<name>", "action": "<action>"}` before the first call to a tool. If it disagrees with these pages, follow the server.
* **Forge:** the [operation index](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/forge/agent-manifest.json) and [function reference](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/forge/functions.md) carry per-action contracts for `forge_query` and `forge_manage`.
* **How to behave:** read the [agent brief](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/agent-brief.md) and the [server reference](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/reference.md) for sign-in, brand scope, confirmations, statuses, and limits.

## Account, brand, and jobs

Full contracts: [Account and brand tools](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md).

| Tool | What it does | Changes things |
| - | - | - |
| [`brands_list`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#brands_list) | Lists the brands you can access. | No |
| [`brands_select`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#brands_select) | Sets the brand the conversation works on and lists its published pipelines. | Yes |
| [`brands_create`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#brands_create) | Starts a new brand. You finish setting it up in the Continuum app. | Yes |
| [`account_map`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#account_map) | Shows connected platforms and accounts, ad accounts, and your role. | No |
| [`accounts_list`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#accounts_list) | Lists the accounts assigned to the brand. | No |
| [`integrations_list`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#integrations_list) | Lists the brand's connections. | No |
| [`integrations_connect`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#integrations_connect) | Returns a one-time link to connect a platform. Links work for 10 minutes. | No |
| [`integration_health_check`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#integration_health_check) | Checks whether a connection is healthy, expired, or disconnected. | No |
| [`brand_knowledge`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#brand_knowledge) | Reads and searches your brand book and knowledge base, checks copy against your voice, and adds, updates, or archives source material. | Yes |
| [`agent_ask`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#agent_ask) | Asks [Jaina](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/jaina.md) or the [Organic agent](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/agent.md) a question. Runs as a job. | Yes |
| [`jobs_status`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#jobs_status) | Checks on a long-running job. | No |
| [`help_describe`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/account.md#help_describe) | Describes any registered tool and its actions: the full input schema, examples, and common errors. | No |

## Ready-made prompts

The connector also offers three prompts your assistant may list in its menu:

| Prompt | What it does |
| - | - |
| `analytics-weekly-review` | A weekly review across social and ads. |
| `analytics-top-and-bottom-posts` | Your best and worst organic posts, and why. |
| `analytics-top-and-bottom-ads` | Your best and worst ads, and why. |

### `brands_list`

Lists the brands you can access.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | No |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Anyone signed in |
| Needs | No brand. |
| Confirmation | None. The call runs when made. |
| Completion | Returns the result in the same call. |
| Retry | Safe to retry: it only reads. |

**Inputs:** none.

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* List brands: `{"name":"brands_list","arguments":{}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `INTERNAL` | Something went wrong on our side. Retry once, then contact support. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |

**Related:** `brands_select`, `brands_create`.

Full schema: `help_describe {"tool":"brands_list"}`. As JSON: [`/mcp/schemas/brands_list.json`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/schemas/brands_list.json).

### `brands_select`

Sets the brand the conversation works on and lists its published pipelines.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | Yes |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Anyone signed in |
| Needs | No brand. |
| Confirmation | None. The call runs when made. |
| Completion | Returns the result in the same call. |
| Retry | Safe to retry: repeating the call gives the same result. |

**Inputs:**

| Input | Type | Required | About |
| - | - | - | - |
| `brand_id` | string\|null | Yes | ID of an accessible brand from `brands_list`, or null to clear only the current session selection. |

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* Select brand: `{"name":"brands_select","arguments":{"brand_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `BRAND_FORBIDDEN` | User lacks access to the selected brand. |
| `SESSION_NOT_INITIALIZED` | MCP session not yet established. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |

**Related:** `brands_list`, `integrations_list`.

Full schema: `help_describe {"tool":"brands_select"}`. As JSON: [`/mcp/schemas/brands_select.json`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/schemas/brands_select.json).

### `brands_create`

Starts a new brand. You finish setting it up in the Continuum app.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | Yes |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Anyone signed in |
| Needs | No brand. |
| Confirmation | None. The call runs when made. |
| Completion | Returns the result in the same call. |
| Retry | Not idempotent. Check the current state before retrying. |

**Inputs:**

| Input | Type | Required | About |
| - | - | - | - |
| `brand_name` | string | Yes | — |
| `website_url` | string | No | — |

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* Start a brand from its website: `{"name":"brands_create","arguments":{"brand_name":"Acme Coffee","website_url":"https://acmecoffee.example"}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `INTERNAL` | Something went wrong on our side. Retry once, then contact support. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |

**Related:** `brands_select`, `brands_list`.

### `account_map`

Shows connected platforms and accounts, ad accounts, and your role.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | No |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Any brand member |
| Needs | An active brand. |
| Confirmation | None. The call runs when made. |
| Completion | Returns the result in the same call. |
| Retry | Safe to retry: it only reads. |

**Inputs:**

| Input | Type | Required | About |
| - | - | - | - |
| `depth` | string | No | One of `platforms`, `accounts`. |

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* Platforms and accounts for the active brand: `{"name":"account_map","arguments":{"depth":"accounts"}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `needs_brand` | No brand is active. Call `brands_select`. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |

**Related:** `accounts_list`, `integrations_list`, `analytics_query`.

Full schema: `help_describe {"tool":"account_map"}`. As JSON: [`/mcp/schemas/account_map.json`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/schemas/account_map.json).

### `accounts_list`

Lists the accounts assigned to the brand.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | No |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Any brand member |
| Needs | An active brand. |
| Confirmation | None. The call runs when made. |
| Completion | Returns the result in the same call. |
| Retry | Safe to retry: it only reads. |

**Inputs:**

| Input | Type | Required | About |
| - | - | - | - |
| `platform` | string | No | One of `instagram`, `facebook`, `tiktok`, `google`, `linkedin`, `youtube`, `x`, `threads`. |
| `search` | string | No | — |
| `limit` | integer | No | — |
| `cursor` | string | No | — |

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* First page: `{"name":"accounts_list","arguments":{"limit":25}}`

### `brand_knowledge`

Reads and searches your brand book and knowledge base, checks copy against your voice, and adds, updates, or archives source material.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | Yes |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Viewer or higher to read. Operator or higher for `add_text`, `add_file`, `add_url`, `upload_url`, `upload_finalize`, `update`, `archive`, `restore`, and `save_permanent`. |
| Needs | An active brand. |
| Confirmation | Writes preview first and return a `confirm_token` with `expires_at`. Confirm with that token after the person says yes. |
| Completion | Returns right away. Longer work continues as a job; read the id in the result. |
| Retry | Retry with the same `idempotency_key` to avoid duplicates. |

**Actions** (`action`):

| action | Required inputs | Other inputs it uses |
| - | - | - |
| `overview` | `action` | — |
| `search` | `action`, `query` | `sources`, `categories`, `limit` |
| `read` | `action`, `source` | `full`, `purpose`, `section`, `design_section`, `format` |
| `validate` | `action`, `copy`, `platform` | — |
| `document_status` | `action`, `document_id` | — |
| `cross_reference` | `action` | `lens_limit` |
| `add_text` | `action`, `name`, `text` | `category`, `retention` |
| `add_file` | `action`, `file_name`, `mime_type`, `file_base64` | `category`, `operation_id` |
| `add_url` | `action`, `name`, `url` | `category`, `retention` |
| `upload_url` | `action`, `file_name`, `mime_type` | — |
| `upload_finalize` | `action`, `upload_path` | `name`, `category`, `retention` |
| `update` | `action`, `document_id`, `name\|category` | `expected_updated_at` |
| `archive` | `action`, `document_id` | `mode`, `confirm_token` |
| `restore` | `action`, `document_id` | — |
| `save_permanent` | `action`, `document_id` | — |

In this table, `a|b` means one of them and `a+b` means together.

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* See what the knowledge base holds: `{"name":"brand_knowledge","arguments":{"action":"overview"}}`
* Search the brand book: `{"name":"brand_knowledge","arguments":{"action":"search","query":"tone of voice for promotions"}}`
* Check copy against the brand voice: `{"name":"brand_knowledge","arguments":{"action":"validate","copy":"Autumn is here. Our new single-origin roast is out now, in a limited batch.","platform":"instagram"}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `CONFLICT` | The item changed or is busy. Read it again, then retry with the current state. |
| `INTERNAL` | Something went wrong on our side. Retry once, then contact support. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The item doesn't exist, or this brand can't see it. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | The sign-in is missing or expired. Reconnect the assistant. |
| `UPSTREAM_ERROR` | A platform or provider returned an error. `details` carries its message. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |
| `needs_brand` | No brand is active. Call `brands_select`. |
| `needs_role` | The person's role is too low for this call. Viewer or higher to read. Operator or higher for `add_text`, `add_file`, `add_url`, `upload_url`, `upload_finalize`, `update`, `archive`, `restore`, and `save_permanent`. Ask an Admin or Owner. |
| `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | This write needs a preview first. Preview, get a yes, then confirm with the returned token. |

**Related:** `creative_strategy`.

Full schema: `help_describe {"tool":"brand_knowledge","action":"overview"}`. As JSON: [`/mcp/schemas/brand_knowledge.json`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/schemas/brand_knowledge.json).

### `agent_ask`

Asks [Jaina](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/performance/jaina.md) or the [Organic agent](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/organic/agent.md) a question. Runs as a job.

**Good to know:**

* Returns a `job_id` right away. Read the answer with `jobs_status`.
* The finished result's `status` is `completed` (it wrote a draft or plan) or `needs_followup` (text only). To continue, send the next question with the same `sessionId`.
* A question sent to the wrong agent returns `needs_correction` with a `suggested_target`.
* When the Organic agent ends with a plan waiting for approval, the result carries `plan_id` and `pending_approval_token`. Commit it with `planner_manage` `approve_week` after the person says yes. The server’s own description names `organic_calendar_approve` for this step; that tool isn’t callable, so use `approve_week`.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | Yes |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Operator or higher. |
| Needs | An active brand. |
| Confirmation | None. The call runs when made. |
| Completion | Returns a `job_id`. Read the result with `jobs_status`. |
| Retry | Not idempotent. Check the current state before retrying. |

**Actions** (`target`):

| target | Required inputs |
| - | - |
| `jaina` | `target`, `query` |
| `organic` | `target`, `query` |

Other inputs, shared by every action (the live schema says which each action reads): `query`, `sessionId`, `context`.

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* Ask Jaina why a metric moved: `{"name":"agent_ask","arguments":{"target":"jaina","query":"Why did our cost per purchase rise last week, and which ad sets drove it?"}}`
* Ask the Organic agent for ideas: `{"name":"agent_ask","arguments":{"target":"organic","query":"Give me three Reel ideas for our autumn launch, based on what performed best last month."}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `needs_brand` | No brand is active. Call `brands_select`. |
| `needs_role` | The person's role is too low for this call. Operator or higher. Ask an Admin or Owner. |
| `needs_correction` | The question went to the wrong agent. Ask the `suggested_target` instead. |
| `needs_followup` | In the finished job result: the agent produced text only. Continue with the same `sessionId`. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |

**Related:** `jobs_status`, `planner_manage`, `analytics_query`.

Full schema: `help_describe {"tool":"agent_ask","action":"jaina"}`. `help_describe`'s `action` takes a `target` value. As JSON: [`/mcp/schemas/agent_ask.json`](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/schemas/agent_ask.json).

## What's next

* [All tools](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools.md): Every tool on one page, and the machine-readable index.
* [Analytics, trends, and competitors](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/insights.md): Organic, paid, and website results by platform: accounts, top posts, campaigns, ad sets, and ads, and more.
* [Organic+ planning and publishing](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/organic.md): Reads and proposes a week of posts, approves it, reschedules and copies posts, and attaches media, and more.
* [Performance+ ads and optimization](https://docs.trycontinuum.ai/mcp/tools/paid.md): Reads your campaign structure; creates paused campaigns, ad sets, and ads; updates or pauses them; builds audiences and lookalikes; and keeps an audit log of every write, and more.

### `intel_competitor_scan`

Runs a fresh competitor scan, the same as the app's **Scan** button.

### `planner_manage`

Reads and proposes a week of posts, approves it, reschedules and copies posts, and attaches media.

**Good to know:**

* `propose_week` runs as a job. `proposal_status` returns its `plan_id` and a `pending_approval_token` that lasts 24 hours.
* `approve_week` commits the whole week in one step and is safe to repeat. The `job_id` from `propose_week` can stand in for `plan_id`, `pending_approval_token`, and `placements`.

| Contract | Behavior |
| - | - |
| Changes things | Yes |
| Listed in your assistant | Always. |
| Role | Viewer or higher for `get_week`, `proposal_status`, and `operation_status`. Operator or higher for every other action. |
| Needs | An active brand. Connection: The one for what you act on: Instagram. |
| Confirmation | Writes preview first and return a `confirm_token` with `expires_at`. Confirm with that token after the person says yes. |
| Completion | Returns right away. Longer work continues as a job; read the id in the result. |
| Retry | Each `confirm_token` works once. Preview again to retry. |

**Actions** (`action`):

| action | Required inputs | Other inputs it uses |
| - | - | - |
| `get_week` | `action` | `week_start`, `timezone` |
| `propose_week` | `action` | `week_start`, `timezone`, `platform_account_ids` |
| `proposal_status` | `action`, `job_id` | — |
| `approve_week` | `action`, `job_id\|plan_id+pending_approval_token+placements` | `operation_id` |
| `reschedule` | `action`, `draft_id`, `day` | `time_of_day`, `expected_updated_at`, `timezone`, `atomicity`, `operation_id` |
| `reschedule_many` | `action`, `targets` | `timezone`, `atomicity`, `operation_id` |
| `copy` | `action`, `day`, `draft_ids\|source_day` | `timezone`, `atomicity`, `operation_id` |
| `attach_media` | `action`, `assets`, `draft_ids\|draft_id` | `replace`, `expected_updated_at`, `atomicity`, `operation_id` |
| `bulk_transition` | `action`, `to_status`, `draft_ids` | `mode`, `confirm_token`, `expected_updated_at`, `atomicity`, `operation_id` |
| `operation_status` | `action`, `operation_id` | — |

In this table, `a|b` means one of them and `a+b` means together.

**Examples** (IDs are illustrative; use the ones earlier calls return):

* Read next week's calendar: `{"name":"planner_manage","arguments":{"action":"get_week","week_start":"2026-11-16","timezone":"America/New_York"}}`
* Propose a week of posts: `{"name":"planner_manage","arguments":{"action":"propose_week","week_start":"2026-11-16","timezone":"America/New_York"}}`
* Move one post: `{"name":"planner_manage","arguments":{"action":"reschedule","draft_id":"8b2d6f0a-4e7c-4b1d-a3f5-7c9e1b3d5f27","day":"2026-11-19","time_of_day":"09:30"}}`

**Errors and statuses:**

| Code | When |
| - | - |
| `CONFLICT` | The item changed or is busy. Read it again, then retry with the current state. |
| `CTX_MISSING_MODE_A_FIELDS` | The call is missing session context. Reconnect the assistant and retry. |
| `INTERNAL` | Something went wrong on our side. Retry once, then contact support. |
| `JOB_ENQUEUE_FAILED` | The job couldn't start. Retry once, then contact support. |
| `JOB_PENDING` | The job is still running. Check `jobs_status` later. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The item doesn't exist, or this brand can't see it. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | An input is missing or wrong, or it changed since the preview. `details` names the field. |
| `needs_brand` | No brand is active. Call `brands_select`. |
| `needs_role` | The person's role is too low for this call. Viewer or higher for `get_week`, `proposal_status`, and `operation_status`. Operator or higher for every other action. Ask an Admin or Owner. |
| `needs_integration` | The brand lacks the connection this call needs. Call `integrations_connect` with the `platform` the result names. |
| `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | This write needs a preview first. Preview, get a yes, then confirm with the returned token. |
